lines.before: 12. **Tests never yield to implementation.** When a test fails, scrutinize the implementation FIRST - dump what the code actually produces, compare to spec, then decide. NEVER weaken an assertion, relax a regex, accept "close enough", catch exceptions silently, or `.skip()` a test to make it pass. Moving a test's LOOKUP location is allowed only after verifying the implementation's output at the new location. **Test value:** every test guards a real use or a real failure, the way a person, caller or agent uses the code - no fluff to raise counts.
lines.after: 12. **Tests never yield to implementation.** When a test fails, scrutinize the implementation FIRST and leave the test as is - dump what the code actually produces, compare to spec, then decide. lines.before: A feature, fix or triage sweep's Swarm Contract (also written as data) is approved by `approve.mjs` (pre-pr-sweep skill), never an agent: same contract, same answer, no tokens. It runs first: an approval prints the owner's notice; only an ASK goes to the owner, whose yes is logged (`--owner-yes`); a hook holds reviewer agents until the log clears this HEAD and contract. It approves only when the tier's and modifiers' roles are there, each with its own question, context, finding shape and budget, within the tier's caps; else the owner decides, told why. First push and launch gate always go to the owner. Each decision and outcome is logged; it pauses after tokens 25% over budget, a third of findings repeated, a bug escaping a passed sweep, or every 10 approvals (the trial review), and only the owner resumes it. Why: a routine sweep need not wait; the log shows when it drifts.
lines.after: A feature, fix or triage sweep's Swarm Contract is approved by `approve.mjs`, never an agent: same contract, same answer. Why: a routine sweep need not wait; the log shows when it drifts.
